vocabulary.meaning_en: here: moving away from something, or going down / reducing
vocabulary.note_ar: لـ off معانٍ كثيرة، وهنا معنيان
vocabulary.note_en: Off has many meanings; this lesson uses two.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have time away from work, a holiday
vocabulary.note_ar: take time off / take a month off
vocabulary.example: I want to take a week off in the summer.
Our new product is really taking off in Italy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to steal; to charge too much; to copy someone's idea
vocabulary.meaning_ar: يسرق / يغشّ في السعر / يسرق فكرة
vocabulary.note_ar: الاسم: a rip-off = شيء سعره أغلى من قيمته
vocabulary.example: Five dollars for this water? That's a rip-off!

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take someone to court to get money
vocabulary.example: Apple sued Samsung for copying its idea.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to sell things at a much lower price to get rid of them
vocabulary.meaning_ar: يبيع بأسعار مخفّضة للتخلّص من البضاعة
vocabulary.example: The shop is selling off last year's phones.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stop employing workers because there is no money or work, not because they did wrong
to make someone leave their job, usually because of their behaviour or work
(business) a cost that reduces the tax you pay
vocabulary.meaning_ar: خصم ضريبي / مصروف يُخصم من الضريبة
vocabulary.example: My new work computer is a write-off.
Travel is a big business expense.

vocabulary.meaning_en: that you must pay tax on

fine_lines.title: laid off vs fired
fine_lines.explanation_ar: laid off: الشركة ليس لديها مال أو عمل، والعامل لم يخطئ، وقد تعيده لاحقًا. fired: طُرد بسبب خطأ أو سوء عمل ولن يعود.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Laid off: the company has no money or work; you did nothing wrong and may be called back. Fired: you lost your job because of your behaviour; it's over.

examples.sentence: She was laid off when the factory closed for three months.
He was fired because he was always late.

fine_lines.title: take off: holiday vs success
fine_lines.explanation_ar: take time off = يأخذ إجازة. Business is taking off = العمل ينجح ويرتفع بسرعة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Take time off = have a holiday. A business takes off = it becomes successful fast.

examples.sentence: I'm taking two days off next week.
Her online shop really took off.

fine_lines.title: Three meanings of rip off
fine_lines.explanation_ar: 1) سرقة بضاعة من متجر. 2) جعل الزبون يدفع أكثر من قيمة الشيء. 3) سرقة فكرة شركة أخرى.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 1) Steal goods from a shop. 2) Make a customer pay too much. 3) Copy another company's idea.

examples.sentence: Someone ripped off the store last night.
I paid $50 for this? I was ripped off.

expressions.phrase: I'd like to take some time off.
expressions.meaning_en: I want a holiday from work.
expressions.example: Boss, I'd like to take some time off in July.
Our new app is really taking off.

expressions.meaning_en: That costs much more than it's worth.
expressions.example: Ten dollars for a coffee? That's a rip-off!
I saw the same bag for half the price; I felt ripped off.

questions.question: "Boss, I'd like to ___ a week ___ in August." (holiday)
"Our new water brand is ___ in Italy." (very successful)
You paid $5 for water that costs $1 next door. You were ___.
questions.explanation_ar: ripped off = دفعت أكثر من القيمة.

questions.question: A company has no money, so it tells workers to go home for now. The workers are ___.
questions.explanation_ar: laid off = سُرّحوا لأن الشركة بلا مال.
questions.explanation_en: Laid off = no money or work.

questions.question: "Nobody buys at $5, so we'll ___ them ___ at $1."
questions.explanation_ar: sell off = يبيع بسعر منخفض للتخلص من البضاعة.
questions.explanation_en: Sell off = sell cheaply to get rid of stock.

questions.question: A business expense that reduces your tax is a ___.
Samsung copied Apple's idea. Samsung ___ the idea.
What's the difference between "laid off" and "fired"?
choices: Fired workers may be called back.
Laid off = you did something wrong.
Laid off = no money or work; fired = your fault.
questions.explanation_ar: laid off ليس خطأك، وfired بسبب خطئك.
questions.explanation_en: Laid off isn't your fault; fired is.
